about_the_game:
An interactive visual novel about Jack, an office siren who just can’t stop saying “That’s what she said.”

Jack is sharp, stylish, and dangerously witty. The only problem? Every accidental innuendo at work triggers her uncontrollable urge to blurt out that phrase. It’s not personal—it’s compulsive. Help Jack survive the workday without getting fired (again) by mastering the art of perfectly timed interjections.

Gameplay
The visual novel plays automatically, but when a juicy double entendre slips in, it’s your moment to shine. Hit 'em with “That’s what she said” at just the right time to keep the story going. Miss the cue, and Jack might be out of a job—or worse, stuck in a painfully awkward silence.

Key Features

  • 🖇️ A Day in the Life of a Disruptive Delight – Play as Jack, the queen of unintended comedy and HR’s recurring nightmare.

  • 🎯 Timing-Based Humor – Don’t just watch—listen for innuendo and strike with precision.

  • 🖥️ Sit Back and React – Auto-play meets interactive comedy. Minimal controls, maximum chaos.

  • 🔁 Multiple Chapters - Play through 3 different stories.

  • Perfect for fans of wordplay, cringe comedy, and the eternal struggle to behave professionally.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mature themes and adult humor delivered through suggestive dialogue and sexual innuendo. There is no nudity, no sexually explicit visuals, and no depictions of sexual acts. All mature content is presented in a comedic, text-based format intended for a mature audience.

The game does not include depictions of sexual violence, non-consensual acts, drug use, or self-harm.
